messages.content: I need to see all the MTNA servers we have. Could you fetch that list for me?

function.name: default_add_default_value
function.description: Adds a default value to a dictionary if the specified key does not exist, ensuring that updates do not overwrite existing entries. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

dict.description: The dictionary to which the default value should be added.

key.description: The key for which the default value is to be set.

default_value.description: The value to set for the key if it does not exist in the dictionary. The type of this value can be any valid Python data type.

function.name: add_mtnards_server
function.description: Adds a new MTNA (Mobile Telecommunications Network Architecture) Rich Data Services (RDS) server to the environment, allowing for the management and retrieval of rich data. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

nickname.description: A user-friendly name to identify the server. For example, 'primary_db_server'.

host.description: The hostname or IP address of the RDS server. Defaults to 'localhost' if not specified.

api_key.description: A unique API key for authenticating requests to the RDS server. This key should be kept secret.

function.name: add_postgres_server
function.description: Add a new PostgreSQL server configuration to the environment allowing the application to connect to it. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

nickname.description: A unique and recognizable name to identify the PostgreSQL server.

host.description: The network address or domain of the PostgreSQL server.

port.description: The network port that the PostgreSQL server is listening on.

database.description: The name of the default database to connect to.

username.description: The username used to authenticate with the PostgreSQL server.

password.description: The password used to authenticate with the PostgreSQL server. Must be provided for security reasons.

function.name: dartfx_help
function.description: Provides a help guide or assistance information for using the DartFX application. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

topic.description: The topic for which help is requested, such as 'installation', 'configuration', 'usage'.

language.description: The language in which the help content is to be provided. Defaults to English.

include_examples.description: Flag to indicate if practical examples should be included in the help content.

function.name: list_servers
function.description: Retrieves a list of servers from the specified environment, filtered by the server type if provided. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

type.description: Specifies the type of server to filter the list. If omitted or if some other type not in the possible types is mentioned by the user, servers of all types are listed.
